ProposedLock: Subspace is an embodied space sandbox/strategy/RPG combining exploration, physical ships, economy/factions and command—not a clone of any reference game.
Full 3D hierarchical simulation is authoritative. Tactical 2D/planar behavior is a command/assist mode only.
Galactic strategic + system operational + local embodied + streamed surface layers with explicit state handoff.
Hierarchical frames, large-world-safe anchors/cell+local coordinates, camera-relative rendering; local physics spaces.
Quantized metric construction coordinates (target 1/32m or 1/16m) without dense voxel storage.
Sparse Parametric Assembly + Authored Kitbash + Semantic Sockets + Hierarchical Subassemblies.
One build vocabulary across ships/stations/surface structures with domain-specific validators and compilers.
Editable assembly is canonical authoring data; render/collision/nav/atmosphere are derived compiled products.
Connectivity is explicit and typed; geometric contact alone does not imply structural/functional connection.
All build mutations are serializable commands usable for undo/redo, persistence deltas, networking, AI and PCG.
Cosmetic damage first, stateful component/armor damage second, geometry split only for structural breach/catastrophic separation.
Power/data/fuel/coolant/ammo/cargo/life-support become explicit networks feeding engineering and damage gameplay.
Strategic command <-> cockpit/direct flight <-> docked <-> on-foot interior <-> EVA <-> surface are explicit state transitions.
Start with planet-scale strategic/orbital bodies plus high-fidelity streamed local surface zones; preserve extension path to broader seamless traversal.
X4/EVE-inspired production/logistics/markets/territory simulated at LOD; not every distant object runs high-fidelity physics.
Design deterministic/authoritative boundaries now; first shipping target is small-session co-op, not MMO infrastructure.
Evaluate Jolt for local rigid-body/character/vehicle physics; never use one solar-system-scale physics world.
Optimize current backend/data model first; backend replacement is evidence-driven after vertical-slice profiling.
Deterministic authored-quality grammar with lineage, exemplar/reference learning, validation and review—not random module soup.
Maturity is evidence-based 0-5; class existence/test pass does not equal player-ready completion.
One home solar system must prove the continuous end-to-end loop before galaxy breadth expands.
Expedition/extraction progression is a supported mode/loop, not the entire game identity.

Subspace remains independently buildable/runnable/testable/certifiable while exposing versioned project metadata, schemas, capabilities and commands allowing Ember to load it as a first-class hosted project.

Ember and the Subspace runtime consume the same canonical versioned authoring schemas and validators; Ember may create derived caches/previews but cannot maintain an incompatible shadow representation.
Nullharbor is a retained design/system lineage folded into Codename Subspace, not a parallel game architecture; approved systems must map to one current Subspace owner and roadmap maturity entry.

Decision: Golden System as authoring certification fixture
ProposedLock: The Golden Home System certifies both the Subspace vertical slice and Ember interoperability through open/edit/validate/launch/runtime-evidence/round-trip workflows.
